turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on the present continuous (am/is/are + -ing)?
turns.tutor:
Hello! Sure.

Form: subject + **am/is/are** + verb**-ing**.
Example: Two children are playing football.
Remember to keep am/is/are in the sentence.

Exercise: Imagine a park. Write one sentence about what someone is doing now.
